tagline: A jewel on the Bosphorus — the iconic mosque, the bridge view, the best kumpir in Istanbul, and a buzzing waterfront that comes alive on weekends.

items.name: Ortaköy Kumpir
items.description: Ortaköy's claim to fame — massive baked potatoes loaded with butter, cheese, and your choice of 30+ toppings. An Istanbul institution.
items.tip: The stalls are all similar in quality. Pick by queue length — a queue is a good sign. Budget ₺80-120.

items.name: Midye Dolma Stands
items.description: Stuffed mussels with spiced rice — a classic Istanbul street snack sold everywhere along the waterfront.
items.tip: Only eat from stands with fresh mussels on display and high turnover. Squeeze lemon on each one.

items.name: Waffle Stalls
items.description: Ortaköy is famous for its street waffles loaded with Nutella, fruit, and whipped cream. A weekend guilty pleasure.

items.name: Banyan Restaurant
items.description: Excellent Asian fusion restaurant with an outstanding Bosphorus view from its terrace. One of the best views in the city.
items.tip: Book the terrace well ahead on weekends. Sunset is the golden hour.

items.name: House Café Ortaköy
items.description: A popular brunch spot with Bosphorus views and a reliable all-day menu. Gets busy but the view earns it.

items.name: Vogue Restaurant
items.description: A long-standing Beşiktaş restaurant with a legendary rooftop terrace view of the Bosphorus and Ortaköy Mosque.

items.name: Ortaköy Mosque
items.description: One of Istanbul's most photogenic landmarks — a Baroque Ottoman mosque perched right on the Bosphorus with the bridge behind it.
items.tip: The best photo angle is from the waterfront to the left of the mosque, facing the bridge. Golden hour is magic.

items.name: Ortaköy Antika Pazarı
items.description: A weekend antiques and crafts market in the square. Good for jewellery, ceramics, handmade goods, and vintage finds.
items.tip: Saturday mornings are best — more vendors and better selection. Prices are negotiable.

items.name: Bosphorus Waterfront Walk
items.description: Walk along the water from Ortaköy toward Arnavutköy for one of Istanbul's best Bosphorus promenade experiences.

tips: Ortaköy gets extremely crowded on weekend afternoons and evenings. Come on weekday mornings for a calmer experience.
The 15-minute walk from Beşiktaş along the waterfront is one of the best urban walks in Istanbul.
Parking is nearly impossible on weekends. Take a taxi or ferry from Eminönü/Beşiktaş.
The mosque is open to visitors outside prayer times — remove shoes and dress modestly.
